description:
Section 73 Application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of planning permission ref.P2019/0401/FUL dated 14/10/2019 for ''Conversion of the ground floor car park and two live/work units and the construction of a side extension over an open yard, for office accommodation (Class B1, now Class E(g)(i)) over ground and mezzanine floors, together with cycle and refuse facilities, alterations to the Banner Street facade at ground floor level, the infill of doors at 1st, 2nd and 3rd floor levels on the western elevation, and the installation of new plant and associated works''

This application seeks amendments for 
- omission of mezzanine provision at the rear part of building
- alteration of side extension including omission of the glazed roof with new rooflights installed and replacement of the  glazed west elevation with brickwork 
- alteration of rear courtyard and front fenestration
